text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the January 2018 Scarborough Community Council agenda titled "Traffic Control Signals at the intersection of Steeles Avenue East and Eastvale Drive (City of Markham)." I would like to move the motion below to help resolve a dangerous situation at the intersection. As you may know, a young woman was killed at the intersection. In order to address safety concerns for pedestrians, and drivers turning onto Steeles Avenue East from Eastvale Drive, I hope you will consider my motion.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District, to report back to the April 4, 2018 meeting of the Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals at the intersection of Steeles Avenue East and Eastvale Drive (City of Markham).
